biotools.summary: CPSign is an open-source software tool for quantitative structure-activity relationship (QSAR) modeling utilizing conformal and probabilistic prediction. It supports several chemical descriptors and modeling methods, including SVM, with features for visualizing results and deploying models as REST services.
